recipe_note: Optimal-action-set teaching on all 4,520 decision boards, native collection, targeted optimality-error review and balanced retention. Safe-only targets are never substituted. The acceptance gate is 4,520/4,520 optimal under the declared deployed score rule. This is finite-domain coverage, not held-out generalization.
